prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that implements real HTTP content-negotiation semantics: it splits media-range parameters, excludes entries with q=0 (explicitly rejected preference), and matches wildcard types/subtypes (e.g. '*/*' or 'application/*'). #2046 instead does an inline `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')` substring check, which has no q-value awareness and no wildcard handling, so it would wrongly accept an Accept header that explicitly disables JSON via `application/json;q=0` or miss valid wildcard Accept headers. #1996's helper is also independently testable/reusable, whereas #2046's fix is inlined into the request handler.
